global.title: Directional wave and sea surface temperature measurements collected in situ by Datawell Waverider buoys located near POINT LOMA SOUTH, CA from 2007/10/03 to 2026/09/01.
global.summary: Directional wave and sea surface temperature measurements collected in situ by Datawell Waverider buoys located near POINT LOMA SOUTH, CA from 2007/10/03 to 2026/09/01. This dataset includes publicly-released data only, excluding all records flagged bad by quality control procedures. A total of 321754 wave samples were analyzed for this area, where the water depth is approximately 961 to 1143 meters.
